course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice simple hypotheticals with om plus skulle.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Talking casually about what someone would do with a free afternoon.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Discussing an imagined but realistic situation.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik imagine what they would do if they had a free afternoon or an unexpectedly quiet day.

main_focus.name: second conditional with om and skulle
main_focus.description: Use om + past tense with skulle + infinitive to talk about an imagined situation.
model_examples: Om jag hade en ledig eftermiddag, skulle jag ta en lång promenad.
Om jag fick gå hem tidigare, skulle jag laga något gott.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use the om...skulle structure naturally 2-3 times.

useful_chunks: Jag skulle nog ta en promenad.
Det låter som en bra idé.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use concrete free-time actions and avoid abstract wish lists.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker raises an imagined free-time situation.
dialogue_shape.middle: They each describe one realistic thing they would do and why.
dialogue_shape.ending: They connect the imagined idea to a possible real plan later.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat the conditional pattern enough for recognition and production

focus: which free-time option is preferred and why
how the imagined idea connects to a real plan

sentence_focus: one sentence with om plus past tense
one sentence with skulle plus infinitive
one sentence about a free afternoon
one sentence giving a reason for the imagined choice
one sentence combining the full om...skulle structure
